{{Top|leg}}
'''Rodian eels''' were creatures, presumably from [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], kept as [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. The kitchen of [[Darkside (space station)|Darkside]] was stocked with Rodian eel at one point.

==Behind the scenes==
The Darkside kitchen also had skinned [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]] and ground [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] meat&mdash;creatures not generally considered food animals&mdash;so it is possible that Rodian eel was also not typically regarded as food.
